description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

The Applications Development Senior Programmer Analyst is an intermediate level position responsible for participation in the establishment and implementation of new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to contribute to applications systems analysis and programming activities.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

**Responsibilities:**

* Strong hands-on experience in S3, Starburst, Oracle database, Databricks and Snowflake preferred.
* Strong hands-on experience with modern software paradigms including cloud-native (AWS, Docker) and microservices
* Experience in implementation of DevOps such as CI/CD and modern best practises such as testing frameworks and the SOLID principles; CI/CD tooling, automation of testing tools
* Passion and commitment for adopting new technologies with exploratory mind-set
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum work environment

* Understanding trading data and experience working in the financial services is required

title: Senior Cloud Administrator (AWS Data Engineer)
description:
:

**ZS** is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by **bringing together data, science, technology** and **human ingenuity** to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a **client-first mentality** to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.

  
:

**What** **You’ll** **Do** : As a Senior Cloud Administrator at ZS you will combine strong data engineering skills with practical cloud infrastructure knowledge. The role is primarily responsible for designing, developing, supporting, and optimizing scalable data pipelines and distributed data-processing workloads. The successful candidate will work across Spark, Hadoop, SQL, Python and Linux, while supporting analytics services and the underlying AWS environment required to run them reliably, securely and cost-effectively. This is a hands-on role for a data engineer who can own complex transformations, tune jobs, troubleshoot production issues, automate recurring operational work, and collaborate with product, engineering, operations and architecture teams. The role also contributes to emerging AI-enabled data workflows through an understanding of Large Language Models, Amazon Bedrock, Agentic AI and Model Context Protocol (MCP).

  

* Design, develop, maintain and support robust data pipelines that ingest, transform and deliver data for analytics, reporting, machine learning and AI use cases.
* Write and review production-grade Python, PySpark and SQL for complex, high-volume data transformations.
* Optimize Spark and SQL workloads for performance, scalability and cost by analyzing execution plans, partitioning, skew, caching, memory pressure and I/O patterns.
* Build reusable ingestion and transformation components, common utilities and automation frameworks that reduce manual intervention and improve delivery consistency.
* Monitor scheduled pipelines and distributed jobs, investigate failures, restore services, and improve observability, alerting, and operational runbooks.
* Perform hands-on troubleshooting across the data-processing layer and supporting cloud infrastructure, including Linux hosts, storage, access, networking and service configuration.
* Conduct root cause analysis for recurring or high-impact incidents and implement long-term remediation to prevent recurrence.
* Apply data-engineering standards for reliability, maintainability, data quality, security and governance throughout the development lifecycle.
* Partner with data producers, consumers, architects, product teams and cloud operations teams to translate requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Contribute to technical design reviews, code reviews, release validation, capacity planning and productionreadiness assessments.
* Support proofs of concept involving LLMs, Amazon Bedrock, Agentic AI and MCP-based integrations where they intersect with enterprise data platforms.
* Work with AWS or other technology vendors and subject matter experts for advanced troubleshooting when required.

**What You'll Bring:**

* 4+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, including Apache Spark, Hadoop ecosystems and Data Warehousing.
* Strong expertise in designing, building, testing, and supporting scalable batch or ETL/ELT data pipelines.
* Hands-on expertise in Spark or PySpark development, including distributed processing concepts and job optimization.
* Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, aggregations, query tuning and data validation.
* Strong Python skills for data processing, reusable frameworks, automation and operational tooling.
* In-depth hands-on experience with Linux, shell utilities, logs, processes, file systems and troubleshooting.
* Proven ability to implement complex data transformations, including cleansing, deduplication, enrichment, aggregation and slowly changing dimension patterns.
* Sound understanding of data warehousing, data lakes, partitioning, file formats, schema evolution and data quality controls.
* Experience diagnosing and optimizing pipeline performance, including parallelism, partition sizing, data skew, memory usage, shuffle behavior and inefficient SQL patterns.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex production issues, perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective actions.
* Understanding of cloud infrastructure fundamentals relevant to analytics workloads, including compute, storage, identity and access, networking, monitoring and cost management.
* Understanding of Large Language Models, Amazon Bedrock, Agentic AI patterns and Model Context Protocol (MCP) concepts.
* Ability to collaborate with cross-functional and globally distributed teams and communicate technical findings clearly to stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience with AWS analytics services such as Amazon EMR, AWS Glue, Amazon Athena, Amazon SageMaker, etc.
* Experience with Amazon S3-based data lakes and related security, cataloging, partitioning and performance  
  considerations.
* Exposure to workflow orchestration or scheduling tools and CI/CD practices for data pipelines.
* Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code or cloud automation tools used to provision and manage analytics  
  environments.
* Knowledge of streaming data, open table formats, data governance, or metadata and catalog solutions.
* Experience supporting secure, regulated or mission-critical analytics platforms.
* Associate-level or higher AWS certification, or relevant data engineering certification
* Fluency in English
* Client-first mentality
* Intense work ethic
* Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach

  
:

**How you’ll grow:**

* Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways
* Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
* Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

**Perks & Benefits:**

At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in India, visit ZS India office locations | Where we work | ZS.

**Hybrid working model:**

We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.

**Travel:**

Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.

**Considering applying?**

At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.

If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.

Candidates must possess or be able to obtain work authorization for their intended country of employment. An on-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.

title: Technical Support Manager — D365 CE or FNO
description:
**Description**

  
  

Company Overview:

When it comes to IT solution providers, there are a lot of choices. But when it comes to providers with innovative and differentiating end-to-end service offerings, there’s really only one: Zones – First Choice for IT.TM

Zones is a Global Solution Provider of end-to-end IT solutions with an unmatched supply chain. Positioned to be the IT partner you need, Zones, a Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) in business for over 35 years, specializes in Digital Workplace, Cloud & Data Center, Networking, Security, and Managed/Professional/Staffing services. Operating in more than 120 countries, leveraging a robust portfolio, and utilizing the highest certification levels from key partners, including Microsoft, Apple, Cisco, Lenovo, Adobe, and more, Zones has mastered the science of building digital infrastructures that change the way business does business ensuring whatever they need, they can Consider IT Done. Follow Zones, LLC on Twitter @Zones, and LinkedIn and Facebook.

Position Overview:

We are seeking a committed and hands-on Technical Support Manager to lead our Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (D365 CE or FNO) support function. The successful candidate will manage a team of more than ten support engineers and maintenance staff, work across multiple rotational shifts to ensure round-the-clock coverage, and serve as the first point of escalation for SLA breaches and production outages.

This role combines deep functional expertise in D365 CE and sales processes (Order-to-Cash) with strong people leadership, process governance, and a continuous-improvement mindset. The Technical Support Manager will also oversee 2 to 5 short-term initiatives (1 to 6 months in duration) focused on bug fixes, technical-debt reduction, and incremental enhancements.

What you’ll do as the Technical Support Manager — D365 CE or FNO :

**Support Operations and SLA Management**
-----------------------------------------

* Operate the D365 CE support function and ensure all support tickets are resolved within agreed SLAs.
* Act as the first point of escalation for SLA breaches, P1/P2 incidents, and production outages.
* Govern the support playbook; continuously improve processes through automation and root-cause prevention.
* Perform detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on critical issues and drive permanent fixes.
* Define, track, and report on key support metrics and KPIs (MTTR, first-response time, ticket aging, CSAT).

**Team and Project Management**
-------------------------------

* Lead and mentor a team of 10+ support engineers and maintenance staff across multiple shifts.
* Manage 2 to 5 short-term projects (1 to 6 months) covering bug fixes, technical debt, and minor enhancements.
* Run scrum ceremonies — sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives — and deliver high-quality fixes on schedule.
* Conduct performance reviews, capacity planning, and skills development for the team.

**Quality and Knowledge Management**
------------------------------------

* Ensure quality checks on knowledge-base articles and ticket-closure documentation.
* Develop new runbooks and update existing ones based on incident learnings and data-driven decisions.
* Promote a culture of documentation, peer review, and continuous learning within the team.

**D365 CE and Sales Process (Must Have)**
-----------------------------------------

* D365 CE: Hands-on experience with Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (D365 CE) as an end-user, support engineer, or developer.
* Sales Process: Strong understanding of the sales process — Sales Orders, Pricing, Quotes, Opportunities, and Accounts.
* O2C / P2P: Proficiency in Order-to-Cash (O2C) and/or Procure-to-Pay (P2P) flows, with depth in one or more of: Sales Order, Pricing, Finance O2C, P2P, Tax.
* Modules: Good to moderate proficiency across D365 CE modules with the ability to navigate, troubleshoot, and configure as needed.

**Technical Skills**
--------------------

* Intermediate to advanced SQL — writing queries, analyzing data, and supporting incident investigation.
* Strong troubleshooting skills with attention to detail and the ability to apply learnings across issues.
* Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Azure Monitor, Application Insights).

**Leadership and Soft Skills**
------------------------------

* Proven ability to manage and motivate teams across multiple geographies and time zones.
* Excellent oral and written communication; able to brief executives and engage with business stakeholders.
* Fast learner with strong problem-solving instincts and a bias for action.
* Calm under pressure during outages and high-severity incidents.

What you will bring to the team:

* 12+ years of overall IT experience, 5+ years of hands-on D365 CE or FNO experience (end-user, support, or developer role).
* 5+ years managing teams of 10 or more members, with proven team-building track record.
* Demonstrated experience supporting users and systems across multiple geographies.

Zones offers a comprehensive Benefits package.
  
  
While we’re committed to providing top-tier solutions, we’re just as committed to supporting our own teams. We offer a competitive compensation package where our team members are rewarded based on their performance and recognized for the value they bring into our business. Our team members enjoy a variety of comprehensive benefits, including Medical Insurance Coverage, Group Term Life and Personal Accident Cover to handle the uncertainties of life, flexible leave policy to balance their work life.

At Zones, work is more than a job – it's an exciting career immersed in an inventive, collaborative culture. If you’re interested in working on the cutting edge of IT innovation, sales, engineering, operations, administration, and more, Zones is the place for you!  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or pregnancy.

title: Digital Technology Advisor - Application Operations Engineering
description:
**Digital Technology Advisor - Application Operations Engineering**

**Do you enjoy working with cutting-edge technology?**

**Would you like to help shape the future of our global energy?**

**Join our team!**

Our Industrial & Energy Technology (IET) team provides industry-leading products and services that optimize the extraction, production and processing of energy. We help a diverse range of customers across the value chain to reduce operating costs and improve productivity. Our team is responsible for the assembly of high-quality and innovative products.

**Partner with the best**

HPC Cloud Architects’ primary responsibilities are to establish the approach for integrating information applications, projects and programs and ensuring alignment with business strategies and drivers, and priorities relevant to Baker Hughes High-Performance Computing (HPC) portfolio.

As a Cloud DevOps Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for:

* Architectural Design: Design and architect high-performance computing clusters and platforms on public cloud providers (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). This includes selecting appropriate compute resources (CPUs, GPUs, FPGAs), storage systems, and high-speed networking solutions.
* Solution Implementation: Implement and deploy cloud HPC solutions using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform or Ansible. This involves configuring virtual networks, setting up distributed file systems (like Lustre, GPFS, or Ceph), and deploying cluster management and job scheduling software (e.g., Slurm, PBS).
* Performance Optimization: Conduct performance analysis and benchmarking to identify and eliminate bottlenecks in the HPC stack. Tune application code for parallel processing using paradigms like MPI (Message Passing Interface) and OpenMP, and optimize hardware and software configurations to maximize performance.
* Collaboration and Consultation: Work as a technical advisor to researchers, engineers, and data scientists, helping them migrate their workloads to the cloud, adopt best practices, and troubleshoot application-specific issues.
* Automation and Management: Develop and maintain automated solutions for provisioning, software deployment, monitoring, and scaling HPC resources. Implement robust backup, disaster recovery, and security protocols to ensure the integrity and availability of the systems.
* Strategic Planning: Stay current with emerging cloud and HPC technologies, influencing product roadmaps and developing strategic plans for the organization's cloud HPC adoption and growth.

**Fuel your passion**

To be successful in this role, you will have

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical field with 10 + years’ experience
* Extensive experience with HPC system design and management, including hands-on experience with hardware (CPUs, GPUs, InfiniBand) and software (compilers, schedulers, parallel programming libraries).
* Deep understanding of parallel computing concepts and programming models (MPI, OpenMP, CUDA).
* Proficiency in performance analysis tools and techniques.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major public cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud)
* Knowledge of cloud services relevant to HPC, such as compute instances, high-performance storage, and networking.
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).
* Strong Linux/Unix system administration skills.
* Proficiency in scripting and automation languages (e.g., Python, Bash).
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with distributed file systems (Lustre, GPFS, Ceph) and job schedulers (Slurm, PBS).

**Work in a way that works for you**

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too.

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

**Working with us**

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

**Working for you**

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect.

  

* Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
* Comprehensive private medical care options
* Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
* Tailored financial programs
* Additional elected or voluntary benefits

  
The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Digital Technology Advisor - Application Operations Engineering**About Us:**

We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.

  
**Join Us:**

Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward.

title: Associate Staff Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

**We're Nagarro.**

We are a Digital Product Engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. We work at a scale — across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world (18500+ experts across 39 countries, to be exact). Our work culture is dynamic and non-hierarchical. We are looking for great new colleagues. That is where you come in!

 **Job Description**

**Requirements**

* Experience: 4+years
* Experience in software development, AI/ML engineering, or applied AI, including at least 1–2 years of hands-on experience building production-grade LLM applications.
* Expert-level proficiency in React.js for developing scalable, responsive, and reusable frontend applications.
* Strong hands-on experience with Python for AI development, automation, backend services, and API integration.
* Working knowledge of Java for backend services, REST API development, and enterprise application integration.
* Practical experience with LLM providers and APIs, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, or equivalent platforms.
* Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, system prompts, structured outputs, JSON schemas, function calling, and tool integration.
* Strong understanding of LLM application development, AI assistants, agentic workflows, and enterprise AI integration.
* Experience with at least one LLM orchestration framework such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, Haystack, or equivalent.
* Hands-on experience implementing RAG pipelines, including embeddings, document chunking, retrieval tuning, grounding, and vector database integration.
* Experience with at least one vector database or search platform, such as pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS, Azure AI Search, or Vertex AI Vector Search.
* Working knowledge of LLM evaluation methodologies, including evaluation datasets, regression testing, and frameworks such as RAGAS, DeepEval, Promptfoo, or LangSmith.
* Experience with FastAPI, Flask, asynchronous programming, Python packaging, and testing frameworks.
* Basic frontend development knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, along with backend API development experience.
* Knowledge of Shell scripting, Linux fundamentals, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Docker.
* Exposure to at least one cloud platform such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Basic understanding of Infrastructure Security concepts, including vulnerabilities, patch management, security logs, IAM, and access controls.

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.

title: Quality Engineer - VOIS
description:
**Who we are**
--------------

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking a **Software Test Automation Engineer** with hands-on experience across manual and automated software testing. You will analyse business requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria; design and execute functional and integration tests; build and maintain reusable automated tests; perform API testing; support CI/CD execution; and manage defects through to closure.

The role requires a sound understanding of SDLC, STLC, test-design techniques and the defect lifecycle, together with practical experience working in Agile teams. You will collaborate with developers, product owners, business analysts and other stakeholders to embed quality throughout the delivery lifecycle and proactively manage quality risks.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Analyse **business requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria** to identify test scenarios, dependencies and quality risks.
* Design, document and maintain **test plans, test scenarios, test cases and test data** for functional and integration testing.
* Perform **manual testing**, including functional, integration, system, regression, smoke, sanity and exploratory testing.
* Design, develop, execute and maintain **automated test scripts** for suitable functional and regression scenarios.
* Identify appropriate **automation candidates** and improve automation coverage while avoiding unnecessary or low-value automation.
* Perform **API and integration testing**, validating requests, responses, error handling and end-to-end workflows.
* Execute automated test suites within **CI/CD pipelines** and investigate test failures.
* Manage **defect identification, logging, prioritisation, retesting and closure**, providing clear evidence and reproducible steps.
* Conduct **root-cause analysis** of test failures, distinguishing product defects from test-data, environment and automation issues.
* Collaborate with developers, product owners, business analysts and other stakeholders to establish clear acceptance criteria and embed quality throughout delivery.
* Participate in **Agile ceremonies**, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives.
* Maintain **requirements-to-test traceability** and appropriate coverage of critical business journeys.
* Track and communicate **test execution status, defect trends, regression results and automation coverage**.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of **test processes, automation frameworks, reusable components and quality-engineering standards**.
* Support test-environment and test-data readiness, highlighting dependencies that could affect delivery.
* Proactively identify **quality risks and improvement opportunities**, helping teams prevent defects as well as detect them.

**Who you are**
---------------

* You hold a Bachelor’s degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline**, or have equivalent practical experience.
* You have 5yrs- 6yrs hands-on experience in **manual and automation testing** across the software development lifecycle.
* You understand **functional, integration, regression, system and exploratory testing**.
* You have practical experience developing and maintaining **reusable automated test scripts**.
* You have experience with **API testing** and validating system integrations.
* You understand **SDLC, STLC, the defect lifecycle and test-design techniques**.
* You have experience using **defect-tracking and test-management tools**.
* You understand **Agile/Scrum methodologies and CI/CD practices**.
* You can apply analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills to investigate test failures and quality issues.
* You communicate effectively and collaborate across development, product, business and technology teams.
* You have experience with **defect identification, reporting, retesting and root-cause analysis**.

**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------

* Work across **manual testing, test automation, API testing and CI/CD-integrated quality engineering**.
* Contribute to quality throughout the software delivery lifecycle rather than focusing solely on test execution.
* Collaborate across development, product, business analysis and other stakeholder groups.
* Influence **test automation coverage, reusable testing components and continuous improvement**.
* Build experience in risk-based quality practices, including defect prevention, root-cause analysis and critical business-journey validation.

**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------

* **Test automation design and maintenance**, including identification of suitable automation candidates.
* **API and integration testing**, including request, response and error-handling validation.
* **CI/CD test execution and failure investigation**.
* Advanced **root-cause analysis and troubleshooting** across product, data, environment and automation issues.
* **Requirements-to-test traceability** and critical business-journey coverage.
* Quality reporting using indicators such as **defect trends, regression results, test status and automation coverage**.
* Cross-functional collaboration within **Agile software delivery teams**.

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
----------------------------------------------

Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.

**Join Us**
-----------

description:

* Strong understanding of AI application testing, debugging, observability, performance optimization, and cost management.

* Familiarity with asynchronous programming, Python packaging, testing frameworks, and application development best practices.
* Knowledge of Shell scripting, Linux fundamentals, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Docker.
* Exposure to at least one cloud platform such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Basic understanding of Infrastructure Security concepts, including vulnerabilities, patch management, security logs, IAM, and access controls.
* Awareness of responsible AI and security practices, including prompt injection, data leakage, hallucinations, bias, and content filtering.
* Familiarity with SIEM platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel or Splunk, including the ability to write KQL or SPL queries for AI-assisted security detection and investigation.
* Basic understanding of Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and cloud security controls such as Network Security Groups (NSGs), Web Application Firewalls (WAF), IAM policies, and conditional access.

* Familiarity with vulnerability management concepts, including CVE, CVSS, EPSS scoring, CISA KEV catalogue, and patch prioritization workflows.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to debug LLM behavior across prompts, retrieval pipelines, and tool integrations.
* Ability to interpret evaluation metrics, application logs, and security telemetry to improve AI quality, reliability, and operational efficiency.
* Demonstrated ownership of AI solutions from prototype to production, including evaluation, observability, testing, and documentation.
* Strong learning agility and adaptability to evolving AI models, frameworks, tools, and development practices.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and deploy LLM-powered features, AI assistants, and intelligent automation solutions to support Infrastructure Security (InfraSec) workflows.
* Build AI-driven capabilities for vulnerability summarization, log triage, remediation recommendations, security policy reviews, configuration assessments, and natural-language querying of security data.
* Develop responsive and scalable frontend applications using React.js, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS for AI-powered internal tools and dashboards.
* Build and maintain backend AI services and APIs using Python, with Java-based backend development wherever required.
* Integrate LLM providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, and open-source models into enterprise applications.
* Design, develop, and optimize prompt templates, system prompts, structured-output schemas, and function-calling workflows.
* Implement end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including document chunking, embeddings, vector store integration, retrieval optimization, and response grounding.
* Develop AI agents and tool-calling workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, Haystack, or equivalent technologies.
* Build evaluation frameworks, golden datasets, and regression test suites to measure LLM accuracy, hallucination rates, response quality, latency, and cost.
* Perform prompt engineering and continuously improve AI outputs through offline and online evaluations.
* Implement responsible AI and security controls, including prompt-injection protection, PII redaction, output filtering, rate limiting, audit logging, and access management.
* Integrate AI services with vulnerability scanners, ticketing platforms, SIEM solutions, monitoring tools, and other security infrastructure to enable automated security workflows.
* Automate AI/ML operations activities such as data preparation, embedding refresh, evaluation runs, health checks, and monitoring using Python and Shell scripting.
* Support application testing, debugging, performance tuning, and cost optimization to ensure reliable and scalable AI solutions.
* Maintain technical documentation, source code repositories, deployment artifacts, and operational procedures.
* Collaborate with security, infrastructure, engineering, DevOps, and data teams to translate business requirements into practical AI-driven solutions.
* Apply infrastructure security principles and cloud security controls while designing and deploying AI services.
* Continuously evaluate emerging LLM models, frameworks, prompting techniques, and evaluation methodologies to improve solution quality and security posture.

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.

title: Data Architect
description:
**About Onit**

We're redefining the future of legal operations through the power of AI. Our cutting-edge platform streamlines enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management and contract lifecycle processes, transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated solutions.

We’re a team of innovators using **AI at the core** to help legal departments become faster, smarter, and more strategic. As we continue to grow and expand the capabilities of our new AI-centric platform, we’re looking for bold thinkers and builders who are excited to shape the next chapter of legal tech.

If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we’d love to meet you.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Data Architect owns the technical foundation of a new data-intensive benchmarking and analytics capability embedded in Onit's enterprise legal operations platform. This is a hands-on, engineering-focused architecture role at the start of a multi-phase programme, and the work is front-loaded: within the first quarter, the Data Architect will select the data platform, design the canonical data model that several product surfaces depend on, define the service contracts, and set the performance and multi-tenant data-isolation guarantees the team builds against. Working closely with the Lead Engineer, Lead Designer, Product Management, and Data Engineering, this role stays in the code, the query plans, and the review conversations rather than handing designs over a wall.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Architecture Ownership: Own the end-to-end architecture for a data-intensive analytics capability embedded in an existing enterprise product.

* Data Platform Selection: Evaluate and select the data platform for large-scale analytical queries, with a documented cost and performance basis for the decision.

* Canonical Data Model: Design a canonical data model that multiple source systems feed and multiple product surfaces consume, ensuring figures reconcile consistently across every surface.

* Service Contracts & APIs: Define and publish service contracts and API specifications using a contract-first approach.

* Non-Functional Requirements: Set and defend latency targets, refresh cadence, and availability requirements, and make them measurable rather than aspirational.

* Multi-Tenant Data Isolation: Design tenant data isolation so that it is enforced structurally, not by convention.

* Architecture Decisions & Reviews: Write architecture decision records that explain trade-offs honestly, including what would change the decision, and review designs and code across the team.

* Cross-Functional Translation: Translate technical constraints into terms Product and Design can act on, and translate their requirements back into architecture.

### **Required Skills**

* Typically 10+ years in software engineering, including substantial time in an architect, principal, or staff-level role owning system-level decisions.

* Demonstrable experience designing data-intensive applications: systems where query performance over large datasets is the central problem.

* Experience evaluating and selecting data platforms for large-scale analytical workloads, with a documented cost and performance basis for the decision.

* Strong SQL and relational data modelling; practical experience with analytical or columnar data stores and a clear view of when each is appropriate.

* Experience designing canonical data models that multiple source systems feed and multiple product surfaces consume, with figures that reconcile consistently.

* Experience designing and operating multi-tenant SaaS systems, including data isolation enforced structurally rather than by convention.

* Hands-on performance engineering: able to profile a slow query, decompose a latency budget, and define what to measure and at which percentile.

* Writes decisions down clearly (e.g., architecture decision records that explain trade-offs honestly) and can defend them to both engineers and non-engineers.

* Working proficiency with AI tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate design exploration, query analysis, and documentation, with the judgment to critically evaluate AI-generated output.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* API design experience with a contract-first mindset.

* Cloud platform experience (AWS), including infrastructure as code.

* Experience retrofitting analytics or reporting capability into an existing transactional product.

* Experience working with incomplete or inconsistent source data, and designing systems that stay trustworthy despite it.

* Background in enterprise B2B SaaS or the legal technology domain.

* Experience with data anonymisation or aggregation where privacy guarantees matter.

**Benefits & Perks That Support You:**

Onit offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support the whole employee at work and beyond:

Health Coverage: Employee and immediate family members.

Time Away: Flexible paid time off and 10 company paid holidays annually.

Family Support: ***Exceptional paid leave for birth parents, non-birth parents, and caregivers. Onit also offers surrogacy and adoption reimbursement.***

Income Protection: ***100% employer-paid life and disability insurance.***

Additional Coverage Options: Voluntary benefits including hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident***.***

Tax-Advantaged Accounts: ***Flexi, NPS***.

Community Engagement: One paid volunteer day each year to give back to the community.

**Our Commitment to Applicants**

We know that not everyone will check every box in a job description. At Onit, we value diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly who we’re looking for.

**Onit Values**

**Customer First -** Customer success is our success. We deliver value, listen, and act on customer needs.

**Purposeful Innovation -** Innovation fuels our growth. We harness creativity to solve problems and lead with the intentions and expertise.

**Win as One -** Teamwork is how we win. We are accountable, act with integrity, and communicate openly.

**Intentional Growth -** Our people are the difference. We create an environment with compelling work, impactful contributions, and career growth.

  

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Network Team Lead
description:
**Role / Job Summary**

We are looking for a Network Lead to provide senior technical leadership and team management across our networking practice. This is a broad networking leadership role — not limited to any single technology domain — spanning routing and switching, WAN (Wide Area Network) and SD-WAN (Software-Defined WAN), data center networking, network security, wireless, cloud networking, and automation. The Network Lead will head a team of engineers (including automation-focused specialists), own recruitment and technical interviewing, define technical standards and architecture direction, and serve as the senior escalation point and client-facing authority for all networking matters. The ideal candidate combines deep, hands-on networking breadth with proven people leadership and delivery ownership.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide senior technical leadership across the full networking stack: routing and switching, WAN/SD-WAN, data center networking, wireless, network security, and cloud networking (Azure, AWS or equivalent).
* Lead, mentor and manage a multi-skilled networking team, including automation engineers, owning technical growth, workload allocation and delivery quality.
* Drive end-to-end recruitment across networking roles: define role requirements, screen candidates, conduct technical interviews, and make hiring recommendations in partnership with the Practice Head.
* Own network architecture design, review and troubleshooting across enterprise and service-provider environments, including interoperability with OSPF (Open Shortest Path First) and BGP (Border Gateway Protocol).
* Provide senior-level oversight of service-provider routing scenarios covering IP/MPLS (Internet Protocol / Multi-Protocol Label Switching), BNG (Broadband Network Gateway) and L3VPN (Layer 3 Virtual Private Network).
* Set direction for network automation adoption, guiding and reviewing Python-based tooling for configuration, testing and operational workflows across the team.
* Own network security posture in collaboration with security teams: firewalls, network access control, segmentation, and zero-trust architecture principles.
* Oversee test strategy and execution, including traffic validation using industry-standard test and traffic-generation platforms, and sign off on test evidence before client delivery.
* Act as the senior escalation point for issues spanning network configuration, automation code, and virtualised infrastructure (for example VMware ESXi).
* Act as the primary client-facing technical authority for networking: translating client requirements into architecture and delivery plans, managing expectations, and reporting progress and risks.
* Establish and enforce engineering standards for configuration and code quality using Git for version control, and drive delivery tracking through Jira.
* Own technical documentation standards, architecture diagrams, test evidence quality, and knowledge-transfer material for client and internal stakeholders.
* Drive capacity planning, onboarding, and continuous upskilling of the team across networking domains — not limited to any single technology.
* Contribute to practice-level initiatives: technology roadmaps, tooling standardisation, and networking capability building.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Broad, hands-on expertise across the full networking domain — routing and switching, WAN/SD-WAN, data center networking, wireless, and network security — not limited to any single vendor or technology.
* Strong depth in service-provider and enterprise routing: MPLS (Multi-Protocol Label Switching), BGP (Border Gateway Protocol), OSPF (Open Shortest Path First) and L3VPN (Layer 3 Virtual Private Network).
* Practical experience with software-defined WAN (Wide Area Network) technologies — configuration, optimisation and troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of network security fundamentals: firewalls, access control, segmentation, and secure network design principles.
* Working proficiency in Python for network automation and test automation, sufficient to set direction and review team output.
* Demonstrated experience leading or mentoring technical teams, including workload management and performance oversight.
* Proven experience recruiting and technically interviewing networking engineers across multiple specialisations.
* Working experience with Git for version control and Jira for collaboration and delivery tracking.
* Industry-recognized networking certifications at associate and professional level as a baseline, with evidence of continued technical currency.
* Excellent client-facing communication skills with professional English proficiency in a multicultural, delivery-focused environment.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Exposure to cloud networking constructs (virtual networks, VPN gateways, cloud-native security groups) on Azure, AWS or equivalent.
* Network Services Orchestrator platforms and YANG (Yet Another Next Generation) model-based service orchestration.
* Test tooling exposure such as industry-standard traffic-generation and network testing platforms.
* SDN/NFV (Software-Defined Networking / Network Functions Virtualisation) virtualisation platforms.
* Expert-level or equivalent advanced-tier networking certification.
* Familiarity with CI/CD (Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment) pipelines and infrastructure-as-code practices for network estates.
* Prior experience in a Managed Services or Staff Augmentation delivery model, ideally across multiple client accounts.
* Exposure to zero-trust architecture and modern network access control frameworks.

**Experience Required**

12–18 years of overall networking experience across multiple domains (routing/switching, WAN, security, data center or cloud networking), including at least 2 years in Python-based network or test automation, and a minimum of 4 years in a team lead, technical lead or people-management capacity — including direct involvement in hiring and interviewing.

title: Senior Integration Health Engineer
description:
**Our Mission**

  

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you're blocked.

We're here to give power to the patient.

For nearly 20 years, we've built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we're going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc's marketplace topower access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from *seeking* to *getting*. We don't want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented Senior Integration Health Engineer to ensure the stability, performance, and reliability of our system integrations. This role focuses on monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimizing integrations between various applications, platforms, and third-party services. The ideal candidate will proactively identify potential issues, resolve system errors, and work closely with development and operations teams to maintain seamless data flow and system connectivity. They will build and maintain secure Claude Code and Glean tooling that improves integration triage, troubleshooting, documentation, and QA while applying evidence-based verification, human review, and measurable quality controls. In addition to technical responsibilities, this role also includes leadership in process improvement, training, and communication across teams and stakeholders.

A Day in Your Life

* Monitor Integration Performance – Continuously oversee system integrations to detect anomalies, latency, or failures.
* Develop AI-Assisted Tooling – Build, maintain, and continuously improve secure internal tooling and AI-assisted workflows using approved tools such as Claude Code and Glean.
* Troubleshoot & Resolve Issues – Diagnose and resolve integration errors, API failures, and data flow disruptions in real-time.
* Maintain System Health – Ensure integrations remain functional, efficient, and up to date with minimal downtime.
* Log Analysis & Reporting – Review logs and alerts to identify root causes of failures and document resolutions.
* Optimize Existing Integrations – Identify inefficiencies in data processing and recommend improvements to enhance performance.
* Coordinate with Engineering Teams – Work closely with developers, DevOps, and IT teams to implement fixes and improvements.
* Ensure Compliance & Security – Adhere to industry standards and best practices, including data protection policies and system security.
* Document Processes & Solutions – Maintain thorough documentation of troubleshooting procedures, integration updates, and system workflows.
* Team Leadership & Communication:

* + Owns Training Initiatives – Develops and leads training sessions to elevate team knowledge and performance.
  + Acts as a Point of Escalation – Handles complex technical issues, providing expert guidance and resolution support.

description:
**Job Description: Principal Engineer, Data Platform (Databricks)**

**About the Role**

We are building our next-generation data platform on Databricks. The Principal Engineer sets the technical direction for how the bank ingests, models, governs and serves data. This is a hands-on role: you will design the detailed lakehouse implementation, set engineering standards for SQL and pipelines, lead the migration from legacy platforms, and mentor engineers across several teams. You will work within the target-state architecture owned by the Solution Architect.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lakehouse design:** Own the detailed design of the Databricks lakehouse: ingestion, bronze/silver/gold layers, Delta Lake design, Unity Catalog setup, and workspace and cluster configuration.
* **Migration:** Lead the hands-on migration of legacy Hadoop/Hive/Spark and warehouse workloads to Databricks, including re-platforming HQL and SQL, validating data parity, and safe cutover.
* **Engineering standards:** Set standards for SQL, PySpark and Delta Live Tables/Lakeflow pipelines, covering code review, testing, CI/CD and observability.
* **Performance and cost:** Tune performance and cost: partitioning, liquid clustering/Z-ordering, file compaction, join and shuffle tuning, Photon, cluster right-sizing and DBU spend governance.
* **Data modeling:** Design canonical, auditable entity models (applications, accounts, customers, transactions) across source systems.
* **Security and compliance:** Implement PII protection, encryption and tokenization, row/column-level security, lineage, retention and audit readiness with Security, Risk, Compliance and Data Governance.
* **Design reviews:** Lead technical design reviews, write architecture decision records, and resolve cross-team technical trade-offs.
* **Mentoring:** Mentor senior and mid-level engineers and raise engineering quality across the data organization.
* **Data products:** Work with Analytics, Data Science/ML, Risk, Fraud and Finance to turn business needs into reliable, documented data products.
* **Evaluation:** Evaluate new Databricks capabilities and tools and recommend adoption where there is clear value.

**Must-Have Skills**

* **Experience:** 12+ years in data or software engineering, with at least 5 years in a technical lead, staff or principal role.
* **SQL:** Expert-level SQL: complex analytical queries, window functions, CTEs, query plan analysis and tuning on very large datasets (billions of rows).
* **Spark and big data:** Deep experience with Apache Spark (PySpark and/or Scala) and the ecosystem: Hadoop, Hive, Kafka, Parquet/ORC/Delta.
* **Databricks in production:** Hands-on production use of Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Workflows/Jobs, Databricks SQL, and cluster and cost management.

* **Data security:** Implementation of PII protection: encryption, tokenization, and row/column-level security.

We’re a team of innovators using **AI at the core** to help legal departments become faster, smarter, and more strategic. As we continue to grow and expand the capabilities of our new AI-centric platform, we’re looking for bold thinkers and builders who are excited to shape the next chapter of legal tech.

If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we’d love to meet you.

**Position Summary**

This is a hands-on Senior Modern workplace engineer role focused on modern endpoint engineering, device identity, security, automation and lifecycle management. The role will own and evolve Microsoft's modern workplace stack with Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot at its core, integrated with Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, endpoint security, application deployment and patching. The successful candidate should be strong enough to solve complex L3 issues independently, but broad enough to understand how endpoint, identity, security and user experience work together.

**Onit's technology environment changes quickly. The successful candidate will be evaluated not only on what they already know, but on how effectively they learn, apply and operationalize new capabilities.**

### **What This Role Is Expected to Deliver**

* Build a secure, scalable and low-touch endpoint platform for Windows devices, with increasing capability across macOS.
* Reduce manual administration through PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and proactive remediation/automation.
* Improve device compliance, deployment quality, patch posture and endpoint security without creating unnecessary friction for users.
* Own endpoint-related projects from design and pilot through production rollout, documentation, change communication and operational handover.
* EPM, SAAS Management, Shadow IT/AI and AI Governance are key projects in Pipeline.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Design, deploy and administer Microsoft Intune for device compliance, configuration profiles, security baselines, enrollment, application deployment and update management.
* Own Windows Autopilot end to end, including device registration, hardware hashes, deployment profiles, Enrollment Status Page (ESP), user-driven and pre-provisioned scenarios, troubleshooting and lifecycle operations.
* Design and maintain Conditional Access controls tied to compliant/corporate devices, MFA and Zero Trust access principles in partnership with security and identity stakeholders.
* Manage the endpoint-related Microsoft Entra ID surface, including device identity, registration, join states, authentication dependencies and access troubleshooting.
* Package, test and deploy Win32, Microsoft Store and line-of-business applications, including detection rules, dependencies, install/uninstall logic and remediation of failed deployments.
* Build PowerShell and Microsoft Graph automation for reporting, compliance, device operations, configuration validation and repetitive administration.
* Create and maintain proactive remediation/detection-remediation logic to address configuration drift, device health and recurring endpoint issues before they become tickets.
* Own Windows patch/update strategy using Windows Update for Business, update rings and related Microsoft capabilities; support application patching and verification processes.
* Implement and improve endpoint security controls including BitLocker, LAPS, attack-surface reduction/security baselines and integration with enterprise security tooling such as CrowdStrike or Microsoft Defender concepts.
* Support and progressively deepen macOS management capability using Jamf Pro/Apple Business Manager, ADE, FileVault and macOS compliance where applicable.
* Act as the L3 escalation point for complex enrollment failures, policy conflicts, Autopilot provisioning issues, application deployment failures and device compliance problems.
* Work across Microsoft 365 services such as OneDrive, SharePoint, Teams and Exchange Online where endpoint or identity policies intersect with the user experience.
* Evaluate new Microsoft/Apple endpoint capabilities, and recommend production adoption when they improve security, supportability or user experience.
* Create technical documentation, SOPs and runbooks; mentor other IT team members and transfer knowledge rather than becoming a single point of dependency.

### **Required Skills - Must Have**

* Strong hands-on Microsoft Intune administration in an enterprise environment.
* Strong Windows Autopilot implementation and troubleshooting experience.
* Strong understanding of compliance policies, configuration profiles, security baselines and device lifecycle management.
* Hands-on application packaging/deployment using Win32 (.intunewin) or equivalent enterprise packaging methods, including detection and dependency logic.
* Hands-on Microsoft Entra ID and Conditional Access experience, especially device-based access and compliance scenarios.
* Strong L3 troubleshooting ability across enrollment, policy, application deployment, authentication and compliance issues.
* Strong PowerShell scripting skills for automation and troubleshooting.
* Practical endpoint security knowledge including disk encryption, endpoint hardening, patching and least-privilege concepts.
* Ability to independently plan and execute technical changes/projects with pilots, rollback thinking, stakeholder communication and post-change validation.
* PIM, SSO concepts (SAML/OIDC), enterprise application registration and broader Entra identity administration.
* Jamf Pro, Apple Business Manager/ADE, FileVault and macOS administration.

### **Adjacent Skills - Good to Have / Learn Quickly**

* Microsoft Graph API automation and reporting.
* BeyondTrust Endpoint Privilege Management (EPM), Microsoft EPM or similar least-privilege tooling.
* CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or comparable endpoint security platforms.
* Microsoft 365 migration or tenant-to-tenant migration experience.
* ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR or similar control/compliance environments.

### **What Success Looks Like**

* Takes independent ownership of the Intune/Autopilot/Entra endpoint stack and becomes the escalation point for complex endpoint problems.
* Automates recurring endpoint work and reduces avoidable manual administration/tickets.
* Improves compliance, patching and endpoint security posture while keeping user experience practical.
* Builds working knowledge in adjacent areas such as Jamf/macOS, EPM and broader identity rather than remaining an Intune-only specialist.
* Demonstrates learnability: can identify a knowledge gap, self-learn, test in a lab/pilot, apply the capability in production, document it and transfer the knowledge to others.

### **Experience & Qualifications**

* 8+ years relevant experience across enterprise IT, Microsoft 365, endpoint/security or related infrastructure disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience owning production systems and resolving complex technical problems, not only following predefined operational procedures.
* Experience working with distributed/global stakeholders and managing technical changes across business teams is preferred.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related discipline.

### **Preferred Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102)
* Microsoft 365 Administrator / MS-102 or equivalent Microsoft 365 administration certification
* Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator (SC-300) - preferred
* Jamf certification - advantage, not mandatory

**Benefits & Perks That Support You:**

Onit offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support the whole employee at work and beyond:

Health Coverage: Employee and immediate family members.

Time Away: Flexible paid time off and 10 company paid holidays annually.

Family Support: ***Exceptional paid leave for birth parents, non-birth parents, and caregivers. Onit also offers surrogacy and adoption reimbursement.***

Income Protection: ***100% employer-paid life and disability insurance.***

Additional Coverage Options: Voluntary benefits including hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident***.***

Tax-Advantaged Accounts: ***Flexi, NPS***.

Community Engagement: One paid volunteer day each year to give back to the community.

**Our Commitment to Applicants**

We know that not everyone will check every box in a job description. At Onit, we value diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly who we’re looking for.

**Onit Values**

**Customer First -** Customer success is our success. We deliver value, listen, and act on customer needs.

**Purposeful Innovation -** Innovation fuels our growth. We harness creativity to solve problems and lead with the intentions and expertise.

**Win as One -** Teamwork is how we win. We are accountable, act with integrity, and communicate openly.

**Intentional Growth -** Our people are the difference. We create an environment with compelling work, impactful contributions, and career growth.

  

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**The future of money is being built right now. At FIS, we help the world’s businesses, banks and communities move, manage and grow money with confidence. Join a team that values fresh thinking, works together to solve complex challenges, and creates technology that powers everyday life.**

As a **Data Engineer, AI Governance**, you will design, build, and maintain the data foundations that support responsible, trusted, and scalable AI across FIS. This role combines deep backend engineering expertise with a passion for data quality, governance, and transparency. You will serve as a data wrangler and problem solver, ensuring data is discoverable, traceable, reliable, and fit for purpose while providing visibility into data lineage, ownership, and usage throughout the enterprise.

* Consolidate and transform data from multiple enterprise sources into trusted, governed datasets for AI and business consumption.
* Establish and maintain end-to-end data lineage, enabling visibility into where data originates, how it is transformed, and how it is consumed.
* Partner with business, technology, and governance teams to define data ownership, stewardship, and accountability models.
* Implement data quality controls, monitoring frameworks, and observability practices to proactively identify and resolve data issues.
* Develop metadata management processes that improve data discoverability, traceability, and governance compliance.
* Support data access governance by helping define, automate, and monitor data access controls and permissions.
* Build and maintain data validation, reconciliation, and audit capabilities that improve trust in enterprise data assets.
* Collaborate with AI, machine learning, and analytics teams to ensure governed data is available for model development and operational use cases.
* Recommend and implement automation opportunities that improve data reliability, efficiency, and operational excellence.

**What you bring**

*Required qualifications*

* Experience as a Data Engineer, Data Platform Engineer, Data Integration Engineer, or similar role supporting large-scale data environments.
* Strong experience building and supporting backend data pipelines using modern data engineering practices.
* Experience with data integration, transformation, cleansing, and consolidation across multiple data sources.
* Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, metadata management, and data lifecycle management.
* Experience establishing and documenting data lineage, data flows, and data dependencies.
* Proficiency with SQL and data modeling concepts in enterprise data environments.
* Experience with cloud-based data platforms, data warehouses, and data lake architectures.
* Knowledge of data security, access management, and governance principles.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Passion for creating high-quality, trusted, and well-governed data products.

*Preferred qualifications*

* Experience supporting AI, machine learning, or responsible AI governance programs.
* Familiarity with data catalog, metadata management, data lineage, or data observability platforms.
* Experience implementing enterprise data quality and monitoring frameworks.
* Experience within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or highly regulated industries.

**The impact you’ll make**

As a **Data Engineer, AI Governance**, you will help establish confidence in the data that powers AI and business decision-making across FIS. Your work will enable clear visibility into data origins, transformations, ownership, and consumption while ensuring high standards of quality, accessibility, and governance. By building trusted data foundations, you will play a critical role in advancing responsible AI adoption and delivering scalable solutions that create long-term value for the organization.

**What we offer you**

Bring your ideas. Build your future. At FIS, you'll find the support, resources and opportunities to develop your career while helping shape the future of financial technology.

We offer:

* Internal career growth opportunities
* Opportunities to innovate in fintech
* Inclusive and diverse team atmosphere

FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.

Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

As a Collaboration Managed Services Engineer (L1) at NTT DATA, you will be the go-to person for ensuring our clients' Collaboration, Contact Centre and Voice systems stay up and running. Throughout the day you’ll be monitoring client infrastructure for any issues and proactively addressing them before they escalate. Your role doesn't stop at issue resolution; you'll also be identifying opportunities to optimize work processes and reduce incidents. Whether it's updating existing knowledge articles, creating new ones, or finding ways to automate routine tasks, you'll actively contribute to enhancing service delivery. Your ability to adapt to changing circumstances and keep a positive outlook will be key to your success.  
  
Effective communication is essential in this role. You'll collaborate across different cultures and social groups, plan activities comprehensively, and ensure smooth handovers during shift changes. Your commitment to placing clients at the forefront of all interactions will help create a positive client experience throughout their journey with us.

* The ability to triage client cases effectively, ensuring that severity and impact is accurate as well as key information is documented in the case.

* Flexibility and adaptability in changing circumstances.

title: Technology Architect
description:
**Project Role :** Technology Architect  
**Project Role Description :** Design and deliver technology architecture for a platform, product, or engagement. Define solutions to meet performance, capability, and scalability needs.
  
**Must have skills :** SAP BTP Application Development  
**Good to have skills :** Python (Programming Language), Node.js  
Minimum **18** year(s) of experience is required  
**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  
  
Summary:
  
The SAP Business AI Development Manager leads the design, engineering, and delivery of responsible, scalable AI solutions on SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP). The role combines hands-on SAP architecture and development expertise with engineering leadership, delivery governance, and stakeholder management. The manager will embed AI and generative AI capabilities into enterprise processes across SAP S/4HANA, SAP SuccessFactors, SAP Ariba, SAP Concur, supply chain, spend, and customer-experience solutions while maintaining clean-core, security, privacy, and responsible-AI standards.  
SAP BTP Development Manager  
  
SAP Business Technology Platform ,AI Engineering ,Generative AI ,Enterprise Application Development  
  
Role: SAP BTP & Business AI Development Manager, Architect  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
Solution strategy and architecture: Define solution approaches and reference architectures for embedded and side-by-side AI extensions on SAP BTP, balancing business value, scalability, security, maintainability, and clean-core principles.  
Engineering leadership: Lead multidisciplinary teams of AI engineers, SAP BTP developers, data engineers, integration specialists, and quality engineers plan capacity, allocate work, remove delivery impediments, and coach team members.  
AI Foundation delivery: Govern development using SAP AI Core, SAP AI Launchpad, and the generative AI hub, covering experimentation, model selection, deployment, inference, monitoring, and continuous improvement.  
Generative AI adoption: Establish standards for prompt engineering, prompt lifecycle management, model evaluation, retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, grounding, and rapid prototyping.  
Business-process integration: Embed capabilities such as intelligent document processing, natural-language interfaces, workflow automation, recommendations, forecasting, and decision support into SAP and non-SAP processes.  
Application development: Oversee SAP CAP, ABAP Cloud, SAP Fiori/UI5, OData, SAP HANA Cloud, Cloud Foundry, and Kyma-based development, including APIs, events, integrations, and reusable services.  
AI-assisted engineering: Guide responsible use of Joule for Developers and SAP Build Code for code scaffolding, explanation, refactoring, test generation, and review support.  
Quality and DevSecOps: Ensure AI-generated and developer-created artifacts are reviewed, validated, tested, secured, traceable, and approved before release drive CI/CD, observability, automated testing, and production-support practices.  
Responsible AI and governance: Implement controls for privacy, security, transparency, content safety, bias mitigation, human oversight, model risk, auditability, and regulatory compliance throughout the AI lifecycle.  
Capability building: Create engineering standards, reusable accelerators, reference implementations, and learning plans that strengthen AI, application development, integration, analytics, and data-engineering capabilities.  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  
Hands-on experience with SAP BTP and relevant services, including SAP AI Core, SAP AI Launchpad, the generative AI hub, SAP HANA Cloud, SAP Build Code, and SAP Integration Suite.  
Strong knowledge of generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and AI observability.  
Proficiency in one or more SAP development stacks: SAP CAP with Node.js or Java, ABAP Cloud, SAP Fiori/UI5, OData, REST APIs, and event-driven integration.  
Experience designing cloud-native applications and microservices on Cloud Foundry and,or Kyma,Kubernetes, supported by Git, CI,CD, automated testing, and secure DevOps practices.  
Good understanding of SAP BTP security, including identity and access management, OAuth, role-based access, secrets management, data protection, and secure API design.  
Working knowledge of AI-enabled business processes in SAP S/4HANA and one or more SAP cloud applications such as SuccessFactors, Ariba, Concur, Sales Cloud, or Signavio.  
Demonstrated ability to convert business opportunities into solution designs, delivery plans, estimates, risks, controls, and measurable outcomes.  
Strong people leadership, stakeholder management, communication, problem-solving, and delivery ownership.  
Preferred Qualifications  
SAP certification in BTP application development, integration, data, analytics, AI engineering, or a related specialization.  
Experience with SAP Joule Studio and the design or orchestration of AI agents.  
Experience with SAP Document AI, SAP Build Process Automation, Event Mesh, and asynchronous architectures.  
Knowledge of SAP HANA Cloud Predictive Analysis Library, Automated Predictive Library, and vector capabilities.  
Experience integrating models and services from Hyperscaler or SAP AI ecosystem partners through governed enterprise patterns.  
Experience delivering AI solutions in regulated environments with privacy, security, data residency, and compliance obligations.  
Familiarity with responsible-AI frameworks, model risk management, evaluation benchmarks, red teaming, and human-in-the-loop controls.  
Experience creating reusable assets, engineering playbooks, and communities of practice for enterprise AI adoption.  
Leadership Competencies  
Strategic orientation: Connect AI investments to business outcomes, adoption, and value realization.  
Technical judgment: Make pragmatic build, buy, reuse, and integration decisions across SAP and partner services.  
Delivery leadership: Manage scope, quality, schedule, cost, dependencies, and operational readiness across concurrent workstreams.  
Talent development: Build high-performing teams through coaching, feedback, knowledge sharing, and structured capability development.  
Executive communication: Explain complex AI concepts, design trade-offs, risks, and value in clear business language.  
Collaboration and ownership: Work effectively across business, architecture, engineering, data, security, legal, risk, and operations teams.  
Measures of Success  
AI use cases delivered on time, within agreed quality and risk thresholds, and with measurable business outcomes.  
Production reliability, security, performance, adoption, and responsible-AI compliance of deployed solutions.  
Reuse of approved architecture patterns, accelerators, components, and engineering standards.  
Improvement in engineering productivity, automated test coverage, release quality, and time to value.  
Stakeholder satisfaction and growth in the capability, proficiency, and retention of the engineering team.  
  
Additional Information:
  
Bachelor s or master s degree in computer science, engineering, data science, information systems, or a related discipline.  
Typically 10+ years of enterprise application or technology delivery experience, including 3+ years leading SAP BTP, AI/ML, data, or cloud engineering teams.

  
15 years full time education
